newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept import duty collection up 21.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept import duty collection up 21.4 pct.

text.p: China collected 62.04 billion yuan ($7.47 billion) in import duties in January to September, up 21.36 percent from the same period a year ago, state television said on Monday.
Collection of duties in 19 major cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou during the first nine months had met their targets for all of 1996, the report said.
The report attributed the rise to an adjustment of China's import tax policy last April and improved customs collection.
The tax adjustment trimmed duties on imports of nearly 5,000 items by an average 35.9 percent and scrapped tariff exemptions on imports of capital goods for foreign firms.
Customs officials had thwarted 1.9 billion yuan worth of tax evasion schemes, the report said without giving further details.
